AboutMe.bio1: I'm a developer passionate about creating end-to-end solutions, combining a polished Frontend with a robust Backend.
AboutMe.bio2: My philosophy focuses on continuous improvement and applying agile methodologies like Scrum to quickly adapt to changes and deliver real value. I constantly seek to optimize processes and learn new technologies that elevate the quality of every project.

ProfessionalCaseStudies.title: Professional
ProfessionalCaseStudies.description: Summary of real cases in enterprise contexts. Technical decisions, architecture approach, and results are shared while preserving client and product confidentiality.

cs-peopleapps-maui-admin.title: Angular Admin for .NET MAUI Ecosystem
cs-peopleapps-maui-admin.imageAlt: Analytics dashboard and enterprise platform modernization
cs-peopleapps-maui-admin.context: Enterprise application with .NET MAUI mobile frontend requiring a web admin panel for operational management.
cs-peopleapps-maui-admin.challenge: Centralize critical administrative functions without disrupting existing operational flows.
cs-peopleapps-maui-admin.approach: Building an Angular admin module for notifications, users, and cross-system management with a modular and maintainable approach.
cs-peopleapps-maui-admin.impact: Greater operational traceability and improved administrative control over key ecosystem features.

cs-createc-medical-platform.title: Medical Consultation and Exam Management Platform
cs-createc-medical-platform.imageAlt: Medical system interface for managing consultations and exams
cs-createc-medical-platform.context: Web application for managing medical consultations and various types of clinical exams in an enterprise environment.
cs-createc-medical-platform.challenge: Design a functional and scalable foundation for operating clinical flows with a clear data structure.
cs-createc-medical-platform.approach: Full-stack implementation with Laravel + Livewire, relational modeling in MySQL, migrations, Composer, and Eloquent ORM.
cs-createc-medical-platform.impact: Technical standardization of the project and a solid foundation for the system's functional evolution.

cs-peopleapps-ecommerce-maps.title: Multi-role E-commerce with Interactive Maps
cs-peopleapps-ecommerce-maps.imageAlt: E-commerce interface with role-based segmentation and location
cs-peopleapps-ecommerce-maps.context: E-commerce project with different operational profiles and geolocation visualization needs.
cs-peopleapps-ecommerce-maps.challenge: Coordinate experience and permissions by role (admin, provider, customer) while maintaining functional consistency.
cs-peopleapps-ecommerce-maps.approach: Developing Angular frontend modules by user type and integrating interactive maps to improve operational flows.
cs-peopleapps-ecommerce-maps.impact: Better operational and navigation experience for users with different needs within the same platform.

cs-peopleapps-legacy-modernization.title: Legacy System Migration to Modern Angular
cs-peopleapps-legacy-modernization.imageAlt: Analytics dashboard and enterprise platform modernization
cs-peopleapps-legacy-modernization.context: Core legacy system in Razor + JavaScript requiring progressive modernization without disrupting operations.
cs-peopleapps-legacy-modernization.challenge: Reduce technical debt and improve maintainability without halting functional business deliveries.
cs-peopleapps-legacy-modernization.approach: Incremental migration strategy to modern Angular applying Signals, OnPush Change Detection, Lazy Loading, and zoneless approach.
cs-peopleapps-legacy-modernization.impact: Greater frontend technical consistency and functional evolution with lower operational risk.
